name: Remix AgroShift Gambia
description:
We are building AgroShift Gambia, a crop-rotation decision-support application for rain-fed farmers in The Gambia.
We are starting a fresh frontend using Google AI Studio, but we are KEEPING our existing Python FastAPI backend.
I have provided:
Our existing FastAPI backend source code.
Our NASA environmental pilot datasets.
Our original Figma UI design.
Your first task is to inspect these materials and understand the complete project.
ARCHITECTURE:
Frontend: React and TypeScript.
Backend: Existing Python FastAPI application. Do not replace it.
Environmental data: Existing cached NASA datasets, processed and served by FastAPI.
Recommendation engine: Python rule-based crop-rotation engine.
Communication: REST API.
PROJECT REQUIREMENTS:
Preserve the visual direction and workflow of the Figma design.
Build a responsive, farmer-friendly interface.
Support field selection and field details.
Collect three seasons of crop history.
Collect farmer priorities and resource constraints.
Display environmental evidence with dataset provenance.
Present three crop-rotation strategies with explanations and trade-offs.
Include strategy comparison and a printable farmer report.
CRITICAL RULES:
Do not rewrite the backend in Node.js.
Do not duplicate recommendation calculations in the frontend.
The backend must perform hard-constraint checks before weighted scoring.
Never convert missing environmental measurements into zero.
Do not invent NASA measurements or claim validated yield improvements.
Respect the spatial and temporal limitations of satellite and modelled data.
Do not make live NASA API requests during the demonstration.
BEFORE BUILDING:
Inspect the backend structure and existing endpoints.
Inspect the NASA dataset files and metadata.
Inspect the Figma design and identify its screens and components.
Determine how the frontend should communicate with the existing backend.
Identify missing backend functionality and API contract mismatches.
Propose the frontend architecture and implementation stages.
Do not modify, replace or generate application files yet.
Return a detailed technical assessment and wait for my approval before implementation.
